title: Soziale Arbeit als Grenzbearbeitung: Herausforderungen, Diskurse und Praktiken
summary: The scope of social work is determined by various boundaries that affect professional self-image, the range of actions permitted and responsibilities. The authors examine the institutional, professional and subjective dimensions of these boundaries, as well as how they are dealt with. This reveals areas of tension between protection and control, participation and exclusion, and openness and limitation.
